title: A storage error while reading a finished run's seal is reported as itself, not as a missing obligation
outcome: A storage error while reading a finished run's seal is reported as itself, not as a missing obligation
acceptance: An undecodable or missing seal still leaves the obligation checks strict
When loading a finished run or its completion seal fails with a SQLite error, the obligation read returns that storage error rather than a missing builtin obligation error, and a test covers it

completion.summary: finished_run_cut_on now returns a SQLite failure reading the finished run or its seal as itself, in the obligation read and in doctor. A missing or undecodable run or seal still gives no cut, so the checks stay strict. Rows of the wrong type, out of range or with invalid UTF-8 count as damage: doctor reports them instead of aborting. A six-case test covers it, mutation-checked for each round's fix. Review took 3 rounds, with the round-3 pair clean, gate 9/9, and the evaluation passed. Landed as 5e4521f and installed as build 2850fe9e.
